The apply, and the two refusals before it

week-14 — twenty resources took three attempts, and the server alone took 9m6s
# ATTEMPT 1 — 16 of 20 created, then the database was refused.
$ terraform apply
Plan: 20 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
azurerm_linux_virtual_machine.app: Creation complete after 48s
azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.db: Creating...

  Error: creating Flexible Server: unexpected status 403 (403 Forbidden)
  RequestDisallowedByPolicy: Resource 'psql-wk14-dev-scus-001' was disallowed
  by policy. Policy identifiers: 'Lab guardrail: only small PostgreSQL SKUs'

# The guardrail from the previous session refused a deliberately SMALL
# server: its allowlist held GP_Standard_D2ds_v5, the composite form the CLI
# accepts, while ARM stores sku.name = Standard_D2ds_v5 with the tier apart.
# It matched nothing, so it denied every PostgreSQL server.

# ATTEMPT 2 — allowlist corrected. The region refused zone-redundant HA.
$ terraform apply
Plan: 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

  Status: "MultiAzHaIsOfferRestricted"
  Message: "Multi-Zone HA is not supported in this region."

# ATTEMPT 3 — ha_mode = SameZone. Same price, same standby, same failover.
$ terraform apply
azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.db: Creating...
azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.db: Creation complete after 9m6s
azurerm_private_endpoint.db: Creation complete after 54s
azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server_active_directory_administrator.app: Creation complete after 1m1s
azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server_database.orders: Creation complete after 13s

Apply complete! Resources: 4 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.
